blocking.issue: L4g-left-1 regression on the Start dialog: when a task is held at a limit (or a waiter waits on a task the person paused), the dialog now adds 'Give your agent work first: add a task on the Tasks tab, click Make ready on a draft there, or ask in Chat, for example "add a task: write the README".' under the new sentence. That is a second, competing instruction; the work exists and only the limit holds it. The dialog's noReadyTask rule leaves out only blockers whose link is /inbox. The fix moved this blocker's link to /settings#other-settings (and to the Tasks tab for 'which you paused') without updating the dialog, so the line now appears and the test id flips to start-session-no-work. No UI test covers the dialog in this state: the real-daemon case checks only client.startCheck().
blocking.evidence: /tmp/frbench/review-l4-starts-carried-steps/bench1/05-b3-start-dialog-paused-at-the-project-s-budget.png (and .txt): 'Nothing can run: "Write the club motto in motto.txt" paused before the project's budget ran out; raise it in Settings. / Open Settings / Give your agent work first: ...'. Answer it in the Inbox, or change what it waits for on the Tasks tab.' for a dependency paused at the project's budget, and for one the person paused (which has no Inbox card). blocking.issue: L4a-left-5's new Undo of a start kept from chat is never refused. It still says it undid the start after that start already ran. CommandLoop.startUndoRefusal returns null for after.kept_start, so the check that refuses other session.start undos once their session ended is skipped. The command's undo then calls cancelKeptStart, which is dropKeptStart(projectId) and drops any kept wait of the project. So a stale Undo also silently drops a later wait: the person's own session waiting to go on after the next limit, or a Start kept later from the dialog.
blocking.evidence: /tmp/frbench/review-l4-starts-carried-steps/bench4-kept-undo/walk7.json and 03-m3-after-undo-after-the-reset.png. Chat's 'run it now' kept the start for 03:44, the session ran at the reset and the task is done (header: 'Done: all 1 task.'). Pressing the reply's Undo answered 'Undone: a session on Map notes on your PC is back to no session.' dropKeptStart is at packages/runtime/src/wiring/billing-pick.ts:1496; the undo is in packages/commands/src/commands/session.ts at the a.kept_start branch.
blocking.expected: Once the kept start has fired, or the project's wait is no longer this start's, the Undo is refused in words like any ended session.start ('nothing left to undo'), and the change row is marked irreversible. Undo drops only the start it kept, never a continuation or a later kept Start. Add a real-daemon case: keep from chat, tick past the reset, then Undo.
